text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooo--h! My gray-colored brain cells are 
tingling! The culprit is youuuu--!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hyah...! What was that all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I told ya, I'm Great Detective 
Golshi-chan! You did it, didn't ya? I've 
got the evidence right here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
D-Detective!? Um, what kind of case 
happened here?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Judging by that reaction, you're not 
the culprit, huh? My bad, my bad, was just 
testing you a bit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I figured that if you were the culprit, 
you'd let something slip about the 
clothespin murder weapon...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So that's how you're searching 
for the culprit...! B-But I swear, I'm not 
the culprit!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san! Won't you let me help you too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to catch the real culprit! We can't 
let bad people run free!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've got good eyes, youngster...! 
Alright! I'm making you my assistant! 
First, let's inspect the scene!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—*Bling*! That's it! I've got it! The 
culprit's goal was the chikuwa all along!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, is it even possible to escape 
outside while dribbling backwards with a 
chikuwa in your mouth!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, piecing together all the deductions 
so far, that's the only conclusion that 
makes sense!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll test it out! Please keep your eyes on 
me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, test it? We're doing that? 
Seriously? Wait wait wait, hold upâ!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Chikuwa in mouf... Here I go! Wheeeeeey!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: S-Satanoooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Haa! Haa...!! Yes, now the locked-room 
mystery has been solved...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Th-This guy... actually went and did it! 
What a crazy bastard...!
